text: The initiative features the deployment of digital twins to guide real-time discharge decisions, allowing operations to remain below design discharge limits even under extreme inflow conditions. K-water's centralized coordination across 20 multipurpose dams minimizes spillway use and maximizes flood absorption. During the July 2025 rainfall event, the dams collectively secured 5.1 billion cubic meters of flood control capacity, demonstrating the effectiveness of preemptive drawdowns and controlled retention.

metadata.solution_name: Controlled reoperation of multipurpose dams for flood control
